description: Gated DeltaNet (Qwen4ExpTextGatedDeltaNet) layer-0 reference fixture. Weight VALUES are a real, contiguous slice of the real Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next checkpoint's model.language_model.layers.0.linear_attn.* tensors (shard model-00001-of-00131.safetensors), truncated from hidden_size=2560/16 key heads/48 value heads down to this tiny shape. head_k_dim/head_v_dim (128) are UNCHANGED -- only the hidden_size and head COUNTS were sliced, preserving the real 3x value:key head ratio. The forward pass itself is the real transformers 5.16.1 Qwen4ExpTextGatedDeltaNet.forward(), run on CPU with cache_params=None, attention_mask=None.
dtype: float32 little-endian, raw flat binary, row-major (C order)
notes: in_proj_qkv/conv1d row layout is [query_rows(key_dim_small) | key_rows(key_dim_small) | value_rows(value_dim_small)], sliced from the SAME row offsets as the real checkpoint's [query(2048)|key(2048)|value(6144)] layout.
norm.weight is NOT sliced: RMSNormGated operates per head_v_dim (128), which is unchanged.

GatedDeltaNet forward internally L2-normalizes q/k, applies sigmoid(beta) update gate and -softplus(a+dt_bias)*exp(A_log) decay gate, then the chunked delta-rule recurrence (torch_chunk_gated_delta_rule in modeling_qwen4_exp.py).
